milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate near the oak_wood trees and face them to demonstrate they have located them. Target is the midpoint between the two oak_wood trees at spawn-relative [4, 2, 3]. max_distance=8 allows the player to 'find' the trees from a reasonable viewing distance. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the trees.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find' task — the player must navigate past the oak trees to the hay block cluster near the village building and face them. Target is the center of the hay block cluster at spawn-relative [12, 0, 14]. max_distance=8 allows finding from a reasonable viewing distance. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking toward the hay blocks.
